name: Peace
verse: Peace I leave with you,
my peace I give unto you.
meaning: Jn 14:27 · The peace of God dwells in your heart and home

name: Shepherd
verse: The Lord is my shepherd;
I shall not want.
meaning: Ps 23:1 · The Lord guides you and cares for you every day

name: Strength
verse: I can do all things
through Christ who strengthens me.
meaning: Phil 4:13 · God gives you strength to overcome every hardship

name: Rest
verse: Come unto me, all you who labor and are heavy laden,
and I will give you rest.
meaning: Mt 11:28 · The Lord lifts every weariness from you

name: Fear Not
verse: Fear not, for I am with you;
be not dismayed, for I am your God.
meaning: Is 41:10 · God is always beside you; you are never alone

name: Love
verse: God so loved the world
that He gave His only Son.
meaning: Jn 3:16 · You are loved by God beyond measure

name: Hope
verse: I know the plans I have for you,
plans of peace and not of harm.
meaning: Jer 29:11 · Your future is full of hope

name: Light
verse: Your word is a lamp unto my feet
and a light unto my path.
meaning: Ps 119:105 · God's word lights every decision you make

name: Shelter
verse: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High
shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
meaning: Ps 91:1 · God shields you from every danger

name: Blessing
verse: The Lord bless you and keep you;
the Lord make His face shine upon you.
meaning: Num 6:24-25 · God's blessing overflows upon you

name: Companion
verse: Behold, I am with you always,
even unto the end of the world.
meaning: Mt 28:20 · The Lord walks with you on every road

name: Ask
verse: Ask and it shall be given you, seek and you shall find,
knock and it shall be opened unto you.
meaning: Mt 7:7 · God hears your prayers

name: Joy
verse: Rejoice in the Lord always;
and again I say, rejoice.
meaning: Phil 4:4 · Joy fills your heart

name: Trust
verse: Commit your way unto the Lord;
trust in Him, and He shall bring it to pass.
meaning: Ps 37:5 · All you entrust to God, He will provide for

name: Patient Love
verse: Love is patient,
love is kind.
meaning: 1 Cor 13:4 · Your family is always full of love

name: Grace
verse: My grace is sufficient for you,
for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
meaning: 2 Cor 12:9 · God's grace is enough for you every day

name: Renewal
verse: Whoever is in Christ
is a new creation.
meaning: 2 Cor 5:17 · A good new beginning awaits you

name: All Things Good
verse: All things work together for good
to those who love God.
meaning: Rom 8:28 · Everything will turn out for the good

name: New Strength
verse: Those who wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength;
they shall mount up with wings like eagles.
meaning: Is 40:31 · You are given new strength and faith

name: Comfort
verse: Blessed are they that mourn,
for they shall be comforted.
meaning: Mt 5:4 · God will soothe your sorrow

name: Daily Bread
verse: Give us this day
our daily bread.
meaning: Mt 6:11 · Your family is well provided for

name: Light of the World
verse: You are the light of the world;
let your light so shine before others.
meaning: Mt 5:14,16 · You are a light to those around you

name: Dawn
verse: Weeping may endure for a night,
but joy comes in the morning.
meaning: Ps 30:5 · After the rain, the sun shines again

name: Family
verse: As for me and my house,
we will serve the Lord.
meaning: Josh 24:15 · God watches over your family

name: Forgiveness
verse: Forgive one another,
even as the Lord forgave you.
meaning: Col 3:13 · Your heart is light and at peace

name: Wisdom
verse: If any of you lacks wisdom,
let him ask of God, and it shall be given him.
meaning: Jas 1:5 · You receive wisdom in your studies and your work

name: Fruit
verse: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness.
meaning: Gal 5:22 · Your life bears much good fruit

name: Good Shepherd
verse: I am the good shepherd;
I know my sheep, and my sheep know me.
meaning: Jn 10:14 · God knows you well and loves you

name: Life
verse: I have come that they may have life,
and have it more abundantly.
meaning: Jn 10:10 · Your life is full and meaningful

name: Success
verse: Commit your works unto the Lord,
and your plans shall be established.
meaning: Prov 16:3 · Your work and business prosper

name: New Heart
verse: A new heart will I give you,
and a new spirit will I put within you.
meaning: Ez 36:26 · Your soul is renewed and joyful

name: Healing
verse: He heals the brokenhearted
and binds up their wounds.
meaning: Ps 147:3 · Every wound of your heart is healed

name: Kingdom
verse: Seek first the kingdom of God,
and all these things shall be added unto you.
meaning: Mt 6:33 · God will add everything you need

name: Salt of the Earth
verse: You are the salt of the earth;
bring the flavor of love to everyone.
meaning: Mt 5:13 · You bring joy to others

name: The Cross
verse: Whoever would follow me,
let him take up his cross daily and follow me.
meaning: Lk 9:23 · God gives you strength to overcome trials

name: Angels
verse: He shall give His angels charge over you,
to keep you in all your ways.
meaning: Ps 91:11 · Your guardian angel always protects you

name: Peaceful Sleep
verse: I will lie down in peace and sleep at once,
for You alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.
meaning: Ps 4:8 · Your nights are restful and peaceful

name: Faith
verse: Faith is the substance of things hoped for,
the evidence of things not seen.
meaning: Heb 11:1 · Your faith grows stronger every day

name: Abundant Grace
verse: Give thanks unto the Lord, for He is good;
His mercy endures forever.
meaning: Ps 136:1 · God's grace pours down upon you

name: The Star
verse: We have seen His star
and have come to worship Him.
meaning: Mt 2:2 · A star guides you toward good things
